race.description: CBT Keith Noud Stakes QTISx Hcp (L)
race.comment: ABOUT TO EXPLODE (6) closed off strongly into third behind NOW IS THE HOUR fresh, who was off and gone at the top of the straight. With that run under his belt and a hot tempo anticipated, he can round them up this time. NOW IS THE HOUR (7) is obviously the main danger after his dominant all-the-way win here here two weeks ago, though he will need to go up another rung conceding 2kgs to ATE, and doubt he gets much piece in front this time. BATTLEFIELD (5) returns and will appreciate a hot tempo. His fresh record his hardly inspiring but his two trials in readiness suggest he can fire fresh. RESTONICA (3)  finished best to fend off a handy one here last month. Is unbeaten at this venue after four starts and gets his chance to extend. JUST PRECIOUS (8) was too bad to be true last week when shooting for the hat-trick but backs up quickly and could be worth another look down in the weights.
